title: Orbit Cradle
summary: A palm-sized, one-piece crescent moon that rocks on one continuous arc while its bridged star appears to climb, crest, and return.
manufacturing: Support-free FDM, one printed part, no assembly
material_assumption: Common rigid filament such as PLA or PETG
interaction: Rock gently from -26° to +26°, then release and observe the return to -26°; these sampled poses are not mechanical detents.
limitations: Digitally verified geometry only; no physical print, durability, or human-use claim is made.
